operations.summary: reco.light.channel-likelihood/1, a development binding: the all-channel photon likelihood (every live channel; hit and no-hit terms on one threshold model, so their probabilities sum to one per channel; saturated channels censored; dead and disabled channels excluded, never unhit) on the stated analytic light model of t04-values-v4.md section 4.3, fitted from one seed or, with --starts multistart, from the budget's starts; --likelihood charge-only (default, stage 1: vertex, direction and E_vis, light-likelihood-product/1, t0 not estimated) or charge-time (stage 2: the joint charge and first-arrival-time likelihood with the noise rate, t0 fitted too, light-likelihood-product/2); with the per-channel probability check; labelled shared-model closure; --starts one (default: stage 2's one joint start) or multistart (charge-time only, stage 3: the starts of the budget file, derived from the data alone, the best converged start reported and every start recorded, light-likelihood-product/3)

inputs.name: readout
inputs.constraint: a light-readout/1 file, role reconstruction-input: per channel the state (live-hit, live-unhit, dead, disabled), the charge, the first time and the readout's saturated flag; its threshold must be the configuration's (one threshold model); a dead or disabled channel has no value (NaN); a hit charge above 1e5, or for charge-time a hit time beyond +-1e6 ns, is outside the model's domain and refused

inputs.name: product
inputs.constraint: the light-likelihood-product/1 (charge-only), /2 (charge-time) or /3 (charge-time, multistart) file to write, only when the run finishes; an existing file is refused, never overwritten

inputs.name: product_id
inputs.constraint: a non-empty identity, recorded in the product header

inputs.name: configuration
inputs.constraint: a light-likelihood-configuration/1 file with exactly the written constants of t04-values-v4.md section 4.3 the model needs; default the t09-sphere/1 configuration beside the script

inputs.name: likelihood
inputs.constraint: charge-only (default; stage 1's likelihood and product, unchanged) or charge-time (the joint charge and first-arrival-time likelihood of stage 2 with t0 in the fit; light-likelihood-product/2)

inputs.name: starts
inputs.constraint: one (default; stage 2's one joint start, its products unchanged) or multistart (needs --likelihood charge-time, refused otherwise: the budget's starts in its order, start 0 stage 2's start; the converged start with the highest ln L is reported, ties within the budget's tolerance to the lowest index, all failed as the kind all-starts-failed; light-likelihood-product/3)

inputs.name: budget
inputs.constraint: a light-likelihood-multistart/1 file (exact keys format, starts, tie_tolerance; start 0 prefit; known start names), recorded by SHA-256 in product /3's header; default the t09-multistart-1 budget beside the script

failure_states.meaning: a live channel's hit and no-hit probabilities do not sum to one within 64 eps (1 + m |ln m|) at its reported point (the T09 sheet's stop, and nothing else: stdout carries status failed with probability_failures above 0); the product is written and records it. A fit failure (no hit channel, iteration budget, not converged, non-finite, no finite covariance; a trial point outside the fit's domain is rejected, never raised) is a recorded outcome with exit 0, counted in fit_failures

an input is refused (missing, malformed, a header key that is not the format's, a threshold other than the configuration's, a channel count other than the geometry's, a dead channel with a value, a saturated flag without a saturation value, a configuration key that is not section 4.3's, a product file that already exists); stdout carries status rejected (core/status.py) and the reason; no product is written; or an internal error (an unexpected exception, a defect of the recipe or reader, never the probability-sum stop): stdout carries status error (core/status.py maps error to 2) and the reason, and no product or partial file is written. The JSON status, rejected or error, tells the two apart
numpy or scipy is missing: stdout carries status missing-dependency, nothing ran

operations.summary: Read a light-likelihood-product/1, /2 or /3 back, refusing a malformed or incomplete product (any malformed field is refused, never an internal error), and recompute ln L (the joint ln L for /2) and the per-channel probability check of every event from the product alone (the T09 sheet's stop); for /3 also every start's record, its start point and ln L, the choice and the reported fit against the chosen start

inputs.name: product
inputs.constraint: a light-likelihood-product/1, /2 or /3 file made with the configuration (and for /3 the budget) given

inputs.name: configuration
inputs.constraint: a light-likelihood-configuration/1 file with exactly the written constants of t04-values-v4.md section 4.3 the model needs; default the t09-sphere/1 configuration beside the script

inputs.name: budget
inputs.constraint: the light-likelihood-multistart/1 budget a /3 product was made with, read for a /3 product only; default the t09-multistart-1 budget beside the script

failure_states.meaning: a live channel's hit and no-hit probabilities do not sum to one in at least one event; the first events are listed

the product is refused (missing, malformed, incomplete, made with another configuration, or its ln L or probability check does not recompute); stdout carries status rejected (core/status.py) and the reason; or an internal error (an unexpected exception, a defect of the recipe or reader, never the probability-sum stop): stdout carries status error (core/status.py maps error to 2) and the reason, and no product or partial file is written. The JSON status, rejected or error, tells the two apart
numpy or scipy is missing: stdout carries status missing-dependency, nothing ran
